datasets.summary: LOCATED AND RETRIEVED a full author result table for hypothalamus (16,955 tested genes per sex and time point). Male 8w-vs-sedentary rows compared with the registered output: 16798 paired genes (author coverage 99.07% of all rows; 155 rows in 71 ambiguous symbols excluded unresolved), Pearson 0.3046, Spearman 0.5667, direction agreement 70.89% of 16796 nonzero pairs. Author FDR<0.05 calls: 11 total, 10 paired, all 10 same sign locally, 0 FDR-significant locally. Fails both author-concordance-v2 routes. Known definition differences: MoTrPAC removed sample 90217015402 (registered Hypoth_Control_M_8w_1) as an outlier; the author model is limma-voom with covariates pct_globin, rin, pct_umi_dup, median_5_3_bias fitted across male time points; the registered model is limma on log2(CPM+1) without covariates, which compresses low-expression effects (slope of registered on author 0.041).

verificationReview.reason: The official MoTrPAC timewise result table (MotrpacRatTraining6moData TRNSCRPT_HYPOTH_DA, male 8w versus sex-matched sedentary control) was retrieved and hashed. Against the registered output, 16798 paired genes give Pearson 0.3046, Spearman 0.5667 and 70.89% directional agreement. MoTrPAC excluded control sample 90217015402, which the registered cohort retains, and fitted limma-voom with technical covariates. The observed difference is not reconciled.
verificationReview.nextStep: Decide whether the registered cohort should follow MoTrPAC's documented outlier exclusion; any covariate-adjusted reconstruction must remain a separate sensitivity analysis.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered limma result on log2(CPM + 1) for eight-week endurance training minus sedentary control in male whole hypothalamus, compared with the official MoTrPAC timewise differential-analysis table.
comparabilityReview.reference: MotrpacRatTraining6moData data/TRNSCRPT_HYPOTH_DA.rda (SHA-256 c92379487df7edf00fd23cb433c4d1fcfcfda06fac295e50d0e6245dc2f4ab62), male 8w rows, 16,955 tested genes, retrieved 2026-11-15.

cohort.note: MoTrPAC lists removed samples 90252015402, 90406015402 and 90217015402; 90217015402 is the registered Hypoth_Control_M_8w_1. The registered fit keeps all five controls, so control membership differs by one animal.

contrast.note: Both estimate male eight-week trained minus sex-matched sedentary control. MoTrPAC fits all male time points jointly with technical covariates; the registered model contains only the two eight-week groups.

features.note: Ensembl IDs mapped with the same pinned Rnor_6.0 Ensembl 96 GTF. 16798 of 16,955 author rows pair by exact symbol; 155 rows sharing 71 symbols are excluded as ambiguous and 2 unambiguous rows have no registered symbol.

effects.note: Pearson 0.3046, Spearman 0.5667, direction agreement 70.89% of 16796 nonzero pairs. Author voom log2 fold changes and registered log2(CPM + 1) differences behave differently at low expression (slope 0.041).

inference.note: MoTrPAC male 8w has 11 FDR<0.05 genes (10 paired, all same sign locally); the registered result has 0 FDR<0.05 genes. Covariates, weights and the excluded sample differ.

coverage.note: Paired genes cover 99.07% of all author male-8w rows; 79.2% of the 21215 registered rows pair.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2: at least 30 paired genes and 90% coverage, plus Pearson and Spearman at least 0.90 or at least 90% directional agreement. Neither numerical route is met.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: A full author result exists and was compared. The registered output meets neither concordance route; the documented sample exclusion and covariate model are plausible causes but have not been tested, so the difference remains unresolved.

additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: MoTrPAC logFC is trained 8w minus sex-matched sedentary control; registered is case minus control; no reversal.

additionalComparisonSpec.note: Male 8w rows only; 155 rows in 71 ambiguous symbols excluded unresolved. 16798 pairs, Pearson 0.304585, Spearman 0.566689, direction 70.892%. Author FDR<0.05 11 (10 paired), registered 0.

proposed.experimentalDesign: MoTrPAC's own DA table records control sample 90217015402 (registered Hypoth_Control_M_8w_1) as removed; the registered n=5/5 includes it. Review whether the registered cohort should follow the consortium exclusion.
